To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The mixed discretized MFIES are proper, 2) The mixed discretization of MFIE is a better choice than the classical one, and 3) A mixed discretization of an integral equation does not necessarily result in a proper discretization.
the mixed discretization scheme of the time domain MFIE is more stable and accurate than the classical discretization scheme.

the mixed discretization scheme is “proper”, i.e., testing functions belong to dual spaces of the basis functions; the mixed discretization leads to better accuracy than the classical discretization scheme; the mixed discretized MOT solution is more accurate than the classically discretized MOT solution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mixed discretization scheme and its application in the MOT solution of the time domain MFIE.
the discretization of the MFIE and the MOT solution of the resulting discretized system of equations.
the mixed discretization scheme of MFIE, which can be viewed as a natural generalization of the classical discretization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mixed discretization is a more accurate scheme than the classical discretization.
mixed discretized MFIES are more efficient and robust than the classically discretized ones.
the mixed discretization scheme for the time-domain magnetic field integral equation is a viable and robust alternative to the classical discretization scheme.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mixed discretization of MFIE is more efficient and more accurate than the classical discretization.
, for time domain MFIEs, divergence-conforming functions should be used as the spatial basis functions and curl-conforming functions should used as the spatial testing functions.
the MOT-MFIE solution with mixed discretization is a viable alternative to the MOT-MFEE solution with classical discretization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the MOT solution of time domain MFIE, divergence-conforming functions are preferred over curl-conforming functions for basis functions and vice versa for testing functions.
the mixed discretization scheme is more accurate than the classical discretization scheme for the MOT solution of MFIE.
the mixed discretization scheme is more robust than the classical scheme for the MOT solution of the time domain MFIE.
